scripts.cf:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply forge-acme --local --config deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply forge-acme --remote --config deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.aws:synth: pnpm aws:bundle && cdk synth --app 'node --experimental-strip-types deploy/aws/app.ts' --output deploy/aws/cdk.out
scripts.aws:deploy: pnpm aws:bundle && cdk deploy --app 'node --experimental-strip-types deploy/aws/app.ts' --output deploy/aws/cdk.out --require-approval never --outputs-file deploy/aws/outputs.json
